I study how urbanization shapes gene flow, genetic drift, and adaptation in organisms that live alongside people. My work combines field ecology, molecular lab work, genomics, and bioinformatics, with a focus on urban arthropods such as bed bugs, cockroaches, black widow spiders, and other arthropods.

**Background** 

- Postdoctoral researcher, Department of Entomology, Virginia Tech, PI: [Dr. Warren Booth](https://www.booth-lab.org/)
- Postdoctoral researcher, Department of Biology, University of Toronto Mississauga PI: [Dr. Marc Johnson](https://evoecolab.wordpress.com/)
- PhD, Integrative Life Sciences, Virginia Commonwealth University, PI: [Dr. Brian Verrelli](https://www.bcverrellilab.org/contact)

I am a co-founder of the Urban Evolution blog, which shares urban evolutionary research with the public, and a member of the Urban Eco-Evo Network.
